name: WX Scroll To Up
author: Wooprex

sections.description:
WX Scroll To Up is a clean, user-friendly plugin that adds a scroll-to-top button to your WordPress website — improving navigation and enhancing user experience, especially on long pages.

Customize the button’s design, position, color, size, and icon style. Smooth scroll animations and a lightweight footprint make it a perfect fit for any theme.

Key Features:

  • Multiple button designs
  • Choose from icons or upload a custom SVG
  • Set button position (left, right, or center)
  • Customize colors, size, and border radius
  • Smooth scroll animation
  • Lightweight and responsive

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wx-scroll-to-up folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Scroll To Up to configure your button styles and options.
sections.faq:
How do I enable the scroll to top button?

Once the plugin is activated, the scroll-to-top button will appear automatically on your site. You can configure its appearance and behavior from the plugin settings page in your WordPress admin area.

Can I customize the button’s design?

Yes! You can choose from multiple predefined designs or fully customize the button’s size, color, position, border radius, and icon.

Is the button mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The button is fully responsive and works flawlessly on all devices, including phones and tablets.

Can I upload my own scroll-to-top icon?

Yes, you can upload your own SVG icon if you prefer something unique instead of using a built-in icon.

How do I reset the plugin settings to default?

Simply clear or modify the saved options on the plugin’s settings page and click “Save Changes” — the button will revert to default settings.
